department: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva Trust (Aarogyasri Health Care Trust), Government of Andhra Pradesh
summary: State cashless health scheme for low-income families. The name was restored to Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva in July 2024; many people still search for it as Aarogyasri.

eligibility.income_limit_note: Sources say family income below about Rs 5 lakh, or a BPL family with a valid ration (rice) card. Confirm the exact rule.
eligibility.exclusions: Government employees are not eligible, except non-permanent, outsourced or contract staff within the income limit (one source).

benefits.cover: Up to Rs 25 lakh per family per year as a floater (shared by the registered household)
benefits.type: Cashless treatment at government and empanelled private hospitals for listed diseases and procedures
benefits.ailments_note: One source mentions 949+ ailments; confirm the current list on the official site

documents.name: Ration (rice) card
documents.why: Shows the household and BPL status

documents.name: Income certificate
documents.why: Proves family income is under the limit

documents.name: Address proof
documents.if_missing: Use any accepted proof; ask the secretariat

steps: Ask the Vaidya Mitra desk at an empanelled hospital to check your eligibility using your registered mobile number or Aadhaar
If not enrolled, get the Health Card enrollment form (or use an approved online service)
Submit it with Aadhaar, rice card and income proof
Get your health card and use it for cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals
official_links_note: Official NTR Vaidya Seva website not yet confirmed. Find it and add it here.
